name: Garden
description: Knowledge base: nested notes with a block editor (TipTap) and Notion-style databases backed by real Postgres tables — table/kanban/list/gallery/calendar views, filters, sorts, relations, rollups and formulas.

endpoints.name: getTree
endpoints.description: Sidebar tree of the active space (header `x-garden-space`, defaults to the caller's first space): top-level pages, sub-pages and databases, plus favorites. Database rows are left out (load them with listChildren). Also returns the id of the space's default "Notes" database (All docs).

endpoints.name: listChildren
endpoints.description: Direct children (pages/databases, or a database's rows) of a record, for lazy sidebar expansion.

endpoints.name: createPage
endpoints.description: Creates a page (note). Under a database it becomes a row of that database; anywhere else it lives in the space's default Notes database. Optional `values` sets properties (fieldId → value). `content` is a TipTap JSON doc.

endpoints.name: createDatabase
endpoints.description: Creates a database (a real Postgres table) with a Tags field and a Table view. `inline: true` marks it as embedded in its parent page's content.

endpoints.name: getRecord
endpoints.description: A page (content + its database's fields + property values) or a database (metadata). Trashed records stay readable.

endpoints.name: updateRecord
endpoints.description: Updates title/icon/cover/content/config/favorite, or moves the record (parentId/position). Moving a page into or out of a database changes the database holding its properties (old properties are dropped).

endpoints.name: updateValues
endpoints.description: Sets property values of a page (fieldId → value; null clears). `title` is accepted as a key. Two-way relations are kept in sync.

endpoints.name: trashRecord
endpoints.description: Moves a page/database and everything under it to trash.

endpoints.name: restoreRecord
endpoints.description: Restores a trashed batch.

endpoints.name: deleteRecordPermanently
endpoints.description: Permanently deletes a trashed record and its subtree (drops database tables).

endpoints.name: getBacklinks
endpoints.description: Pages that mention this record.

endpoints.name: getDatabase
endpoints.description: Database metadata, fields (system + user, with computed value types) and views.

endpoints.name: queryRows
endpoints.description: Rows of a database. With `viewId` the view's filter/sorts apply; explicit `filter`/`sorts` override them. Every field — incl. rollup and formula — is filterable and sortable (compiled to SQL).

endpoints.name: createField
endpoints.description: Adds a field (a column named by its uuid in the database table). Relation: set config.relation.databaseId, `twoWay` creates the reverse field. Rollup: config.rollup. Formula: config.formula.expression, e.g. prop("Price") * prop("Qty").

endpoints.name: updateField
endpoints.description: Renames, reconfigures or changes the type of a field. Type changes convert existing values (ALTER through a temp column).

endpoints.name: deleteField
endpoints.description: Deletes a field and drops its column.

endpoints.name: createView
endpoints.description: Adds a view (table, kanban, list, gallery, calendar).

endpoints.name: updateView
endpoints.description: Updates a view's name, type or config (filter, sorts, groupBy, fields…).

endpoints.name: duplicateView
endpoints.description: Duplicates a view.

endpoints.name: deleteView
endpoints.description: Deletes a view (not the last one).

endpoints.name: search
endpoints.description: Full-text search over titles and note content in the active space. `databaseId` limits to that database's rows (relation pickers).

endpoints.name: federatedSearch
endpoints.description: Gateway federated search: searches notes and databases across all of the caller's spaces.

endpoints.name: listTrash
endpoints.description: Trashed pages/databases (batch roots).

endpoints.name: emptyTrash
endpoints.description: Permanently deletes everything in trash.

endpoints.name: uploadAsset
endpoints.description: Uploads an image (raw body, image/* content type, ≤10 MB; optional `x-file-name` header and `recordId` query). Returns its URL.

endpoints.name: getAsset
endpoints.description: Serves an uploaded image (workspace-checked).
